gloss: to pour into; to wash down

definitions.gloss: to pour into; to wash down
definitions.explanation: To pour a liquid or fluid substance into a container, mold, or opening; also to swallow food or medicine by washing it down with a drink.

examples.japanese: コンクリートを{型|かた}に{流|なが}し{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To pour concrete into the mold.

examples.japanese: {錠剤|じょうざい}を{水|みず}で{流|なが}し{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I washed down the tablet with water.

examples.japanese: {溶|と}かした{金属|きんぞく}を{型|かた}に{流|なが}し{込|こ}んで{部品|ぶひん}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: Molten metal is poured into a mold to make the parts.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive godan verb. Xを(Yに){流|なが}し{込|こ}む. A compound of {流|なが}す (to pour, to let flow) and {込|こ}む (to put in), stressing that the liquid is directed into a specific place.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {型|かた}に{流|なが}し{込|こ}む: to pour into a mold
- {一気|いっき}に{流|なが}し{込|こ}む: to gulp down in one go
- {薬|くすり}を{水|みず}で{流|なが}し{込|こ}む: to wash down medicine with water
